title: Grilled Pineapple and Chorizo Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring chorizo and pineapple on skewers, grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Argentinian chorizo
ingredients.notes: Look for chorizo labeled as 'Argentinian' or 'Mexican' for a more authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Delicate sweet onions
ingredients.notes: Red or yellow onions will work too, but delicate sweet onions add a nice sweetness

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.amount: 10-12 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
ingredients.notes: Soaking the skewers will prevent them from catching fire on the grill

instructions: 2. Thread chorizo, pineapple, and onion chunks onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. Brush lime juice on both sides of the skewers.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chorizo is cooked through and the pineapple is caramelized.
6. Remove from heat and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
8. Garnish with lime wedges, if desired.
